units.title: 四级选词：帆边细带显示的气流
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: The Threads at the Sail
materials.text:
During a sailing club’s lesson on shore, a tutor showed learners a small model sail with coloured threads ____1____ to its surface. The threads were fastened at selected points, leaving their ends free to move. They gave a visible indication of ____2____, the movement of air across the sail, which the eye could not otherwise see directly.

A fan supplied a ____3____ stream of air, held at an even strength rather than changing repeatedly. The tutor then turned the sail to change its angle. Some threads lay almost ____4____, parallel to the table rather than hanging straight down. Others began to ____5____, moving rapidly and irregularly instead of pointing smoothly behind the sail.

The tutor asked the learners to ____6____ both sides before describing what had changed. Looking at only one set of threads could leave part of the behaviour unnoticed. She used the term ____7____ for the side facing away from the wind, explaining its meaning before asking anyone to use it.

Next, the fan was varied to imitate ____8____, brief bursts of stronger wind. A thread’s position changed with these bursts, so a single frozen photograph could not show the whole sequence. Learners made short notes about the ____9____ in which each thread pointed as well as how much it moved.

The model did not include every force acting on a real boat. Its purpose was to connect visible movement with a question about air. The tutor reminded the class that the threads revealed the invisible flow ____10____, through its effect on a small object. They did not provide a complete measurement of every condition on the water. Recognising what a simple indicator could show was as useful as noticing its limits.

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: fastened at selected points解释attached固定在表面。slack为松弛、steady为稳定，transparent透明不说明连接；其他候选不构成该过去分词连接关系。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: movement of air across sail直接定义airflow气流。pressure为压强不等于空气运动，direction只方向、instruments为仪器，其他名词不指该流动过程。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: even strength rather than changing解释steady稳定的。continuous仅不断不保证强度均匀，transparent透明、slack松弛、horizontal水平、leeward背风均不定义强度稳定。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: parallel to table而非垂下定义horizontal水平。steady表稳定不表角度，slack松弛不等于平行；leeward是背风侧，transparent透明不表空间方向。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: moving rapidly irregularly定义flutter飘动。observe观察以学习者为主体，非线条自身动作；其他词不作began to后的这种快速摆动动词。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: before describing及looking at both sides要求observe观察。flutter指飘动不能以both sides为观察宾语；其余候选非该查看动作原形动词。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: side facing away from wind直接定义leeward背风侧。direction为方向，horizontal水平不指背风，pressure压强与steady稳定不定义相对风的一侧。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: brief bursts stronger wind定义gusts阵风。instruments仪器、airflow泛指流动、pressure压强均非复数短促强风；其他词词性或含义不符。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: in which thread pointed要求direction指向。pressure为压强，airflow空气流不自然作线头指向in which结构，instruments为器具；其他词非该方向名词。

questions.prompt: The Threads at the Sail: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: through effect on small object说明indirectly间接显示。其余候选没有表示借助可见后果认识不可见气流的方式副词；continuous等形容词不能直接修饰revealed。

units.title: 四级选词：冰箱背后的热量
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Why the Back Feels Warm
materials.text:
In a household science class, learners were asked why the back of a refrigerator could feel warm while its ____1____, the space inside the cabinet, stayed cool. Their teacher used a simplified diagram to follow the movement of heat rather than describing the appliance as a box that simply produced cold.

A working fluid ____2____ around a closed system, repeatedly travelling through its pipes. In one part, the liquid ____3____ into a gas. During this change, heat is ____4____ from the cabinet’s contents and the surrounding inside space. Energy leaves the area that the user wants to cool.

The ____5____ drives part of the cycle by increasing the gas pressure. Later, as the fluid gives heat to the room, it ____6____ back into liquid. The warm surface outside the cooled compartment is therefore connected to the movement of heat out of the cabinet.

The walls contain ____7____ that slows heat passing between the room and the cooled space. This protective layer does not stop every transfer forever. When the door is opened, warmer room air can enter and the system has more heat to remove.

A ____8____ monitors the cooling condition and controls when the equipment runs according to its setting. It responds to ____9____, a measure of how hot or cold something is, rather than counting how many times a person has looked inside.

The teacher also pointed to the need for ____10____ around relevant outside parts, space and air movement that allow heat to be carried away. Blocking that area can interfere with the intended operation. The class’s diagram left out many engineering details, and different appliances use different designs. It nevertheless explained why cool storage and a warm exterior could be parts of the same process, rather than evidence that the appliance was contradicting itself.

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: space inside cabinet直接定义interior内部。insulation为隔热层、ventilation通风、compressor压缩机、thermostat温控器都不是柜内空间本身。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: repeatedly travelling closed system为circulates循环。releases释放需合适宾语，evaporates蒸发和condenses凝结是局部相变非整个管路周回；其他项非该单数主语动词。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: liquid into gas定义evaporates蒸发。condenses方向相反，circulates循环不保证相变，releases需宾语而非into gas表示自己变气；其他词不作该相变谓语。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: heat from cabinet into working fluid为absorbed吸收。sealed为密封不是热被接收，releases为主动单数词形不能作is后被动，其他候选非该过去分词。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: increasing gas pressure定义compressor压缩机。thermostat监测控制开停，不是压气部件；interior空间、insulation隔热层、ventilation通风均非该机械。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: gas back into liquid定义condenses凝结。evaporates是反向蒸发、circulates泛循环、releases为放出不是自身变液；其他词词性不合。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: walls protective layer slows heat transfer定义insulation隔热。ventilation空气流通反而非墙内阻热层，interior为空间，thermostat控制器、compressor机械均非此材料层。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: monitors condition、controls when runs according setting定义thermostat温控器。compressor执行压缩非监测设定装置；temperature是被监测量而非控制装置；其他候选非该器件。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: measure how hot cold直接定义temperature温度。interior空间，ventilation空气流动，insulation隔热材料均非冷热程度量；其他候选不符合定义。

questions.prompt: Why the Back Feels Warm: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: space and air movement allow heat away定义ventilation通风。insulation阻热与外侧散热需求不同，interior为柜内空间；其他名词非外部空气交换条件。

units.title: 四级选词：六点单元的凸点组合
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Reading a Pattern of Dots
materials.text:
A local library’s introduction to braille began with six empty circles printed in two vertical ____1____, three circles in each line from top to bottom. The instructor explained that these circles represented possible dot ____2____ within a cell. Different raised and unraised combinations formed patterns that a reader could distinguish.

On the practice cards, the dots were ____3____ into the paper, pushed outward so that they stood above the surface. Participants used their ____4____, the sensitive ends of their fingers, to feel each pattern. This made the system ____5____, intended to be read through touch rather than by looking at ink alone.

The instructor stressed that the ____6____ of the dots mattered, not simply how many were present. Two cells with the same number of raised dots could represent different things if those dots occupied different places. Turning a card around also changed how its pattern was encountered, so every practice sheet had a clear top edge.

A cell shown alone did not explain every use of the same pattern. Its interpretation could depend on ____7____, the surrounding signs and the particular writing system in use. The instructor avoided pretending that one introductory English alphabet card could explain all braille codes and conventions.

More advanced material could include ____8____, shortened forms representing words or groups of letters. These were introduced only after the basic exercises. Learners then followed a ____9____ of cells from one to the next, reading an ordered series rather than treating a page as an unordered collection of bumps.

Finally, the librarian showed how staff ____10____ approved material into a braille version. Producing the right patterns required knowledge of the relevant code, not merely replacing every printed character with an arbitrary group of raised dots. The introductory activity helped participants appreciate a reading system; it did not claim to make them experienced readers in one afternoon.

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: two vertical且three top to bottom直接指columns列。positions为位置非两垂直列名，sequence顺序、arrangement布局、context语境均非所定义两列。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: possible dot positions为单元内各可能点位。columns只有两列但点位六个，abbreviations缩写、fingertips指尖均不是点可占的格位；其他候选不合定义。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: pushed outward stand above surface为embossed压凸。isolated为隔离、rotated为旋转，都不说明纸面变凸，identical/adjacent等形容词也不表造凸点动作。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: sensitive ends fingers直接定义fingertips指尖。positions位置、columns列、abbreviations缩写是符号或抽象位置，不是身体触摸部位；其他项含义不符。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: read through touch rather than ink sight直接定义tactile触觉的。fluent流利、identical相同、adjacent邻接、isolated独立都不说明感知通道。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: same number but different places说明arrangement排列重要。sequence后文指定跨单元的先后，这里为一格内部空间排布；context周边解释条件不是点位布局，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: surrounding signs and writing system解释context语境。arrangement指格内点位布局，sequence只是先后而非完整解释环境；其他候选不命名所述上下文条件。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: shortened forms representing words letters定义abbreviations缩略。columns列、positions点位、fingertips指尖都不是简写形式，sequence为顺序，其他词词性不合。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: ordered series one cell next定义sequence序列。arrangement可泛布局但这里强调先后顺序且第6空定义格内布局；context周边语境不等于ordered series；其他名词不指序列。

questions.prompt: Reading a Pattern of Dots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: approved material into braille version指transcribe转写。rotated/embossed是过去式不能接staff此处一般现在及into version的转写义，其他项非适合的动词原形。

units.title: 四级选词：蚂蚁分岔路上的气味线索
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Two Routes to the Food
materials.text:
For a classroom model of ant movement, students read a description of a fictional ____1____, a group of ants living together. The ants could reach food by either of two paths. One ____2____ was shorter than the other, so an ant travelling at the same speed could complete it sooner.

As ants moved, they left a ____3____, an odour that others could detect. This was a ____4____ signal carried by substances rather than by a spoken instruction or a drawing. Returning ants could add to the material left along the path.

The model began with some ants choosing each branch. Ants taking the ____5____ path could return earlier and leave further marks there before ants on the long branch completed their journeys. This earlier return could increase the chance that another ant followed the same way.

Repeated use ____6____ the trail, strengthening the signal rather than weakening it. But the signal did not remain unchanged forever. Some material ____7____ into the air, and the remaining trace could lose strength. The model therefore involved both addition and loss, not a mark that grew without limit.

Students next imagined a ____8____ placed across the familiar path, an obstruction the ants could not pass directly. A different way around it was a ____9____, a diversion from the original line. An ant did not need to understand the whole layout as a human map reader might. Local responses could contribute to a changing pattern.

The tutor emphasised that the description was a simplified model rather than a complete account of every ant species. It connected the behaviour of an ____10____ ant, one organism acting locally, with a pattern produced by many. Changing one condition could change the result, so the class examined the stated assumptions before treating any route as a guaranteed final choice.

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: group ants living together定义colony蚁群。individual是单体非群体，departures离开、traces痕迹均非共同生活群落，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: one route was shorter指两路径之一。detour为绕行但此时未有障碍绕路，scent气味、barrier障碍、decay衰减均不是最初路径名。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: an odour others detect定义scent气味。traces为复数不能接a，chemical作物质名也非此处嗅觉线索定义；route路径、barrier障碍不指气味。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: carried by substances rather than spoken drawing定义chemical化学信号。dispersed是分散不说明信号媒介，shorter长度、individual个体均不定义物质传递的性质。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: earlier return before long-branch ants锁定shorter较短。dispersed分散、individual单独、chemical化学均不表示路径更短；其他候选词性不合。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: strengthening rather than weakening定义reinforced加强。evaporated蒸发为损失并不增强，dispersed是分散，与strengthening signal的增强方向不符；其余非合适过去式。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: into the air及material loss定义evaporated挥发。reinforced强化与损失相反，decay原形词形不合且不等于进入空气，其他项不作该过去时过程。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: obstruction cannot pass directly定义barrier障碍。detour是绕行路径，route普通路径、scent气味、colony蚁群都不是堵住熟路的障碍物。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: different way around it、diversion定义detour绕路。route泛路径但第2空占用且此处专指偏离原线绕障；barrier为物体、departures复数不接a，其他项无此专义。

questions.prompt: Two Routes to the Food: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: one organism acting locally定义individual单个的。chemical只表化学性质、dispersed分散、shorter较短均不表达一只而非群体；其他候选不适合an后定语。

units.title: 六级选词：树轮气候重建的校验范围
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: A Climate Record Written in Wood
materials.text:
In a fictional research seminar, a tree-ring measurement was introduced as a ____1____, an indirect indicator used to investigate a variable that had not itself been recorded for the full period. The width of a ring was observable; a past season’s temperature was the quantity the researchers hoped to infer.

The exercise used a species with ____2____ rings formed once each year. Counting alone was not treated as sufficient to assign every date. Researchers compared overlapping patterns among samples to build a ____3____, an ordered sequence tied to years. An error in placement could make a real pattern appear to occur at the wrong time.

For a period with thermometer records, the team carried out ____4____, relating the measured ring property to known temperature observations. A statistical ____5____ showed how the two varied together in that period. The association did not establish that temperature was the only factor influencing growth.

Moisture, shade and local damage could also matter. An interpretation was ____6____ if the effect attributed to temperature was mixed with another influence that had not been adequately distinguished. The seminar therefore asked students to state the assumptions behind the proposed link, not merely copy a fitted line.

The researchers sought to ____7____ the analysis on additional appropriate samples, repeating it to see whether the result held beyond one selected tree. Agreement could strengthen the argument without proving that every tree everywhere responded identically.

They were cautious when asked to ____8____ from the observed range to very different past conditions, extending the relationship beyond where it had been tested. Evidence of ____9____, changes over time rather than perfect constancy, was important, but the inferred size of those changes still depended on the model.

The final account distinguished temperatures measured ____10____ with instruments from temperatures reconstructed through the wood. Both could inform a history, but they did not have the same evidential origin. The exercise’s purpose was to make the chain from material measurement to climatic interpretation open to examination.

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: indirect indicator infer unrecorded variable直接定义proxy代用指标。indices泛指标为复数且不接a，chronology为时序，calibration为校准，correlation为相关，均非所定义间接替代物。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: once each year直接定义annual年度的。synchronous为同步、lagged为滞后、dormant为休眠、residual为残余，均不指一年一次的形成周期。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: ordered sequence tied years定义chronology年代序列。calibration为关系标定、correlation为共变，proxy代用指标，variability变异性，均不命名具体历年排列。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: relating ring property known observations定义calibration校准。correlation只是其后报告的相关关系，chronology是已建立时序；其他名词不指用已知观测标定关系的过程。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: statistical及how two varied together定义correlation相关。calibration是标定过程不直接等于共同变化指标，variability是单个量变化程度，chronology为时间排序，均非此关系名。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: effect mixed another undistinguished influence定义confounded混杂。lagged为滞后、synchronous同步、dormant休眠、residual残留都不表示混入未区分因素；其他候选词形或含义不符。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: repeating analysis additional samples明确定义replicate重复验证。extrapolate是延伸到未试范围，非再取适当样本重复；其余候选不作to后的该原形动作。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: beyond range tested直接定义extrapolate外推。replicate重复不等于跨范围延伸，其他词非该动作原形；不能把证据范围外延伸说成已有重复。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: changes time rather perfect constancy定义variability变异。correlation两量共变、chronology序列、calibration标定、proxy代用物均不直接指时间变化性质。

questions.prompt: A Climate Record Written in Wood: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: with instruments直接解释instrumentally通过仪器地。其余候选无表示仪器直接测量方式的副词；annual等形容词不能修饰measured，且与重建来源区别不符。

units.title: 六级选词：证人问答中的翻译归属
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Whose Words Are in the Record?
materials.text:
In a fictional training hearing, the person making an account and the person translating it occupied different roles. The ____1____ carried speech between languages; that role did not make the translator the source of the events being described. The exercise asked trainees to keep this distinction visible in their notes.

The hearing used ____2____ interpreting: a speaker completed a segment before the translated version followed, rather than both being delivered at once. Pauses and turn boundaries therefore had to be managed without changing who had answered a question.

One trainee left out a short qualification equivalent to “as far as I remember”. This ____3____ removed part of the original statement rather than merely making its grammar smoother. The revised version sounded more certain than the speaker had been. Accuracy concerned the degree of commitment as well as the event mentioned.

Another exercise focused on ____4____ meaning, what an utterance did in a situation rather than the dictionary definitions of its words alone. A polite question could function as a request, for example. Students also considered ____5____, the level and style of language used in the relationship. They were warned against converting every hesitant ordinary reply into confident formal prose.

When the source wording was genuinely unclear, the trainee was asked not to make one interpretation silently ____6____ as though the speaker had stated it directly. The remaining ____7____, the possibility of more than one meaning, needed a procedure for clarification rather than an unannounced solution invented by the translator.

The record required clear ____8____ of each contribution, identifying who had said what and when the interpreter sought clarification. A ____9____ who described an event remained distinct from the language professional who conveyed the account.

For comparison, a source-language transcript recorded the spoken words ____10____, word for word, instead of replacing them with a summary. Even this transcript could not by itself settle every interpretive issue. The exercise treated a record as a set of attributed contributions, not an anonymous stream of sentences whose speakers and qualifications no longer mattered.

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: person carries speech between languages定义interpreter口译员。witness为事件叙述者，与该角色明确不同；attribution归属、paraphrase释述、visibility可见性非这个人。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: speaker completes segment then translation rather at once定义consecutive交替传译。contemporaneous表同时期不表示分段后译，explicit明确、pragmatic语用、verbatim逐字均不是这种轮次形式名称。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: left out qualification、removed original part定义omission遗漏。paraphrase为换述通常仍传意，attribution归属、ambiguity歧义、deference敬让不等于删去限定语。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: utterance does in situation rather dictionary alone定义pragmatic语用。explicit明确、contemporaneous同一时期、consecutive交替、verbatim逐字均不表示语境中的行为功能。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: level style language relationship定义register语域。deference只是尊让态度不是全部语言层级风格，paraphrase换述、ambiguity歧义、visibility可见性均非该定义。

questions.explanation: possibility more one meaning直接定义ambiguity歧义。omission遗漏不等于多个释义，paraphrase换述、attribution归属、deference敬让均非多义可能性。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: identifying who said what定义attribution归属。register语域、visibility可见性、paraphrase释述均不直接标明说话人；ambiguity多义与清晰说话归属不同。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: who described an event且与language professional分开，witness证人。interpreter为语言转换者已占第1空且此句正区分，其他候选不命名这一事件陈述人。

questions.prompt: Whose Words Are in the Record?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: word for word instead summary定义verbatim逐字。sequentially依次只说次序不保证不改词，contemporaneous形容同时期而不表逐字方式；其他候选没有此准确复制原话的义。

materials.title: The Red That Had Disappeared
materials.text:
A fictional film archive examined a colour ____1____, a film element in which tonal and colour relationships had to be interpreted through the appropriate reproduction process rather than viewed as an ordinary positive picture. Its light-sensitive ____2____, the coated layer on the base, had changed unevenly over time.

The material had ____3____: its condition had worsened, and a simple new scan did not automatically recover every original colour relationship. The archivists distinguished recording the film’s present state from proposing how an earlier projection might have looked.

A dated costume photograph served as a ____4____ for some colour decisions, a point of comparison rather than a newly copied film. It was not assumed to show every scene under the same lighting. The team documented which adjustments it could support and where it could provide only a limited clue.

Digital controls allowed changes to ____5____, the intensity of colour, and to ____6____, the difference between lighter and darker areas. Increasing either could make a picture appear more striking without making it historically better supported.

The original ____7____, the amount of light reaching the film during shooting, was another factor. A dark scene might have been intended to look dark. Correcting every shadow to the same brightness could erase a deliberate effect rather than restore lost information.

The conservator therefore adjusted regions ____8____ where the evidence justified different treatment, rather than applying one identical change everywhere. A visible ____9____, a join between pieces of film, was recorded in the material history. It was not automatically removed as though every physical mark were an error introduced by the scanner.

Where evidence remained insufficient, an account of the intended colour involved ____10____, an inference beyond what could be securely established. The final documentation separated this from directly supported decisions. It made the restoration inspectable without claiming that the archive had obtained an unmediated window onto the film’s first screening.

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: first sentence explicitly defines negative film element, contrasting direct ordinary positive viewing。frame是一帧、duplicate副本、composite合成均不说明这里特定反像元素；其他候选不符合该介质名称。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: light-sensitive coated layer on base直接定义emulsion乳剂层。splice为接片，frame为单帧，negative是整个元素而不是其感光层；其他词不指该涂层。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: condition worsened直接定义deteriorated劣化。duplicate为副本、composite合成均非此恶化过去分词，其他候选词性不合且不表状态变坏。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: point of comparison explicitly reference参照，且明说rather than newly copied film排除duplicate。conjecture为推测非实存比较源，frame单帧不能指这张服装照在论证中的参照功能。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: intensity colour定义saturation饱和度。contrast后定义明暗差，exposure为拍摄入光量、uniformity均一性都不是颜色强度指标。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: difference lighter darker定义contrast对比度。saturation色强、exposure拍摄受光、uniformity均匀均不等于明暗差异；其他候选非该控制参数。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: amount light reaching film shooting定义exposure曝光。saturation和contrast是影像属性而不是此次定义的受光量，reference参照、conjecture推测均非拍摄参数。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: regions where evidence different rather identical everywhere定义selectively有选择地。其余候选无此方式副词，uniformity为名词不能代替区域差别处理的副词。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: join between pieces film定义splice接片。frame单帧不是两片接点，emulsion涂层、negative元素、composite合成并不具体指物理拼接处。

questions.prompt: The Red That Had Disappeared: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: inference beyond securely established说明conjecture推测。reference为证据参照、uniformity均一、exposure曝光、contrast对比均不指证据不足时推断的认识性质。

units.title: 六级选词：软件依赖链中的许可义务
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Use each word at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: The Library Inside the Library
materials.text:
In a fictional software workshop, a team inspected a small application that relied on an external code library. That library was a ____1____, a component needed by another component to work. It in turn used a second library that the application’s authors had not chosen directly.

The second relationship was described as ____2____: it reached the application through an intermediate component rather than a direct selection. Looking only at the application’s own short list would therefore miss part of the chain.

For each component, the team checked its ____3____, the stated grant of permissions together with its conditions. A public download button alone did not explain every permitted use. The terms could include ____4____, duties that accompanied the permission rather than optional expressions of gratitude.

The exercise distinguished private use from ____5____, passing copies on to other people. The imagined terms required a particular notice when copies were passed on. They did not say that every possible action triggered the same duty.

A change to the component was a ____6____ of its code. Whether that change altered the requirements depended on the stated terms, so the trainees read the relevant text rather than infer a universal rule from the fact that code had been edited.

One required notice provided ____7____, credit identifying the original contributors. It did not make those contributors the authors of every later change. The team also asked whether the components’ terms were ____8____, able to be complied with together in the planned distribution. Familiar labels were not treated as substitutes for checking the actual conditions.

Where the workshop’s imagined terms required it, the team would ____9____ specified information, making it available to the intended recipients. The report stated ____10____ which requirement had prompted that action, directly and unambiguously rather than leaving the reason implied.

The exercise did not conclude that every publicly available library imposed identical conditions. Its lesson was to map the relevant chain and connect each planned action to the permissions and duties actually stated for it.

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: component needed another to work定义dependency依赖项。repository是代码存储库，fork为分支副本，license许可、warranty保证均不是此所需组件角色。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: through intermediate rather direct selection定义transitive传递性的。inherited泛继承、proprietary专有均不精确表达经中间依赖关系，compatible为可兼容、explicitly为副词也不合。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: grant permissions with conditions定义license许可。warranty为保证不等于授权，repository存储地点、fork副本不命名允许使用的条款文书。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: duties accompanied permission直接定义obligations义务。attribution是可能的一项署名要求而非此处复数义务总称，modification修改、redistribution再分发是行为非责任总类。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: passing copies other people定义redistribution再分发。modification改代码不等于给人副本，fork分支副本、dependency依赖不命名传递复制品的动作。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: change to code直接定义modification修改。redistribution复制分发可不改，attribution署名不等于改变源代码，fork副本可能含或不含修改，其他项不直接等于此定义。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: credit identifying original contributors直接定义attribution署名。warranty为保证、license授权总条款、repository仓库均不指贡献者致谢身份；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: able complied with together定义compatible兼容。proprietary专有不表示两组条件能否同履，inherited继承、transitive传递不定义相容，其他词词性或意思不符。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: making specified information available recipients直接定义disclose披露。fork作动词建立分叉不表示公开指定信息；其他候选无该会使信息可获得的原形动词。

questions.prompt: The Library Inside the Library: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: directly unambiguously rather implied直接定义explicitly明确地。其余候选没有此表达显性方式副词，inherited等分词不能直接修饰stated表清楚说明。
